detail.title: Directive Adherence vs. Adaptive Intelligence
detail.summary: This notebook updates the analysis of failure modes in autonomous systems, specifically examining how strict adherence to potentially misaligned or incomplete directives in high-stakes domains (like CBRN) can result in catastrophic safety failures.
